_comment: Axiom Dashboard Definition - Import via Axiom API or recreate manually in UI
_docs: See docs/observability.md for APL query documentation
name: Yaffle Job Pipeline
description: Monitor webhook-to-job flows, queue times, and execution durations

charts.name: Webhook Volume by Event Type
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body startswith "webhook received" | summarize count() by ['attributes.webhook.event'], bin(_time, 5m)

charts.name: Job Lifecycle Events
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body in ("job.created", "job.claimed", "job.completed", "job.failed") | summarize count() by body, bin(_time, 5m)

charts.name: Queue Wait Time (p50)
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body == "job.claimed" and isnotempty(['attributes.duration.queue_wait_ms']) | summarize p50 = percentile(['attributes.duration.queue_wait_ms'], 50) by bin(_time, 5m)

charts.name: Queue Wait Time (p95)
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body == "job.claimed" and isnotempty(['attributes.duration.queue_wait_ms']) | summarize p95 = percentile(['attributes.duration.queue_wait_ms'], 95) by bin(_time, 5m)

charts.name: Run Duration by Job Type (p50)
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body in ("job.completed", "job.failed") and isnotempty(['attributes.duration.run_ms']) | summarize p50 = percentile(['attributes.duration.run_ms'], 50) by ['attributes.job.type'], bin(_time, 5m)

charts.name: Job Success Rate (%)
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body in ("job.completed", "job.failed") | summarize total = count(), completed = countif(body == "job.completed") by bin(_time, 5m) | extend success_rate = round(todouble(completed) / todouble(total) * 100, 2)

charts.name: Recent Failed Jobs
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body == "job.failed" or body == "job.stale_timeout" | order by _time desc | take 20 | project _time, ['attributes.job.id'], ['attributes.job.type'], ['attributes.error.message'], ['attributes.duration.run_ms']

charts.name: Jobs Blocked by Concurrency
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body contains "blocked by" | summarize total_blocked = sum(['attributes.blocked']) by bin(_time, 5m)

charts.name: Active Jobs (Running)
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body == "job.claimed" and _time > ago(1h) | summarize running = dcount(['attributes.job.id']) - dcount(['attributes.job.id'], body in ("job.completed", "job.failed", "job.cancelled", "job.stale_timeout"))

charts.name: Jobs by Type (Last Hour)
charts.apl: ['yaffle'] | where body == "job.created" and _time > ago(1h) | summarize count() by ['attributes.job.type']
